subtitle: A meat-free cooked breakfast with Quorn sausages, egg and hash browns, suited to vegetarians who want a full morning plate.
quickAnswer: The Wetherspoons vegetarian breakfast costs a typical {price}, varies in price by pub, and contains {calories} kcal. It comes with a fried egg, two Quorn vegetarian sausages, baked beans, two hash browns, a roasted tomato, a flat mushroom and a slice of toast. taste:
This breakfast combines savoury Quorn sausages, crisp hash browns and earthy mushroom, with a juicy roasted tomato providing contrast. The sausages and hash browns are the central flavour and texture pairing: savoury bites alongside a comforting crunch. A freshly fried egg with a golden yolk adds another familiar cooked-breakfast element, without meat taking the lead.

Baked beans come in a generous helping, so they are a substantial part of the plate rather than a small accompaniment. Warm toast completes the selection, giving you something to eat alongside the egg and beans. Served piping hot, this is a varied breakfast with plenty of contrasting textures, rather than a single main ingredient with a few extras.

For vegetarians, useful comparisons include Beans on Toast, Mushroom Benedict and the Vegetarian Breakfast Wrap. Choose this plate when the combination of Quorn sausages, egg, hash browns and vegetables is what you want. If you need a vegan option instead, compare the separately listed Vegan Breakfast rather than assuming this dish can be adapted.
